methods.label: Count corner posts and gaps
methods.explanation:
First count the posts on each side, including both corners. Each noncorner post is counted once, but each of the four corner posts is counted twice. Thus these four side counts total \(20+4=24\).

Let \(n\) be the number of posts on one shorter side, including its corners. One longer side then has \(2n\) posts. Opposite sides have equal lengths and the same spacing, so
\[
2n+2(2n)=24,
\]
which gives \(n=4\). A shorter side therefore has \(4\) posts, and a longer side has \(8\).

There is one fewer gap than posts on a side because both endpoints have posts. The side lengths are consequently
\[
4(4-1)=12\text{ yards},\qquad
4(8-1)=28\text{ yards}.
\]
The garden's area is \(12\cdot28=336\) square yards, choice B.
